summary: Iteration 81 — Budget + transaction alert pipeline VERIFIED end-to-end on the review account (jaleter.appreview@gmail.com). BACKEND: 14/14 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration81_alerts_pipeline.py against the live preview API in ~3.3s. Every review-request item confirmed: (1) prefs GET→PUT→GET round-trip persists exactly (enabled, perCategory {p50,p80,exceeded}, singleExpense {enabled,threshold} all preserved to the value/type). (2) BUDGET 80% (spent 800 / budget 1000) → category_80 alert titled 'Budget warning' with '80%' in body. (3) BUDGET 100% EXACT (spent 1000 / budget 1000) → category_100 titled EXACTLY 'Budget fully used' (NOT 'Budget exceeded') with '100%' body copy. (4) OVER BUDGET (spent 1100 / budget 1000) → category_100 titled 'Budget exceeded' with '$100.00 over' in body — dollar delta rendered correctly. (5) DEDUPE: repeating identical evaluate-budget for all three sub_ids returns created=[] every time (composite alert_state _id u/{user}/{period}/{sub}/{type} does its job). (6) UNDER THRESHOLD (spent 400 / budget 1000 = 40%) → created=[] and no alert_state slot claimed. (7) PREFS RESPECTED: PUT enabled=false + evaluate-budget crossing 100% → created=[] AND no alert_state slot claimed (verified by direct Mongo lookup), then re-enable → identical body fires exactly one category_100 (proves suppression was ephemeral, not dedupe collision). (8) TX ALERT INCLUSIVE — the off-by-one fix: POST evaluate-transaction {id:txA, amount:500} with singleExpense.threshold=500 CREATES a large_transaction alert titled 'Large transaction detected' with '$500.00' and 'Test Store' in the body. (9) TX $499.99 with threshold 500 → created=null. (10) TX $750 → alert with '$750.00' in body. (11) Repeating txA → created=null (tx dedupe key u/{user}/tx/{tx_id}/large_transaction). (12) INBOX: GET /api/notifications lists all iter81 alerts with correct titles/bodies/timestamps; unread-count reflects actual state; PATCH /notifications/{id}/read decrements unread-count by exactly 1. (13) PUSH LAYER REACHED: all persisted notifications have delivery_status ∈ {sent, failed} (never left as 'created') and sent_at set — the pipeline reaches send_push() every time; in this preview environment EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is a placeholder so upstream returns 401 and delivery_status='failed' is expected and correct (server logs: 'push_service - ERROR - EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid at trigger' fires exactly once per alert). (14) CLEANUP DONE: mark-all-read → unread=0, prefs restored to app defaults (enabled=true, perCategory={}, singleExpense={enabled:false, threshold:200}), all iter81 synthetic notifications + alert_state slots deleted from the review account so evaluators see a clean inbox. FRONTEND (light, 390×844 mobile viewport, Expo web preview): logged in via iframe #btnLogin → jaleter.appreview@gmail.com / Jaleter029496! → dashboard renders immediately (home-profile visible, 'Good evening, Apple.' greeting, Jaleter Coach card, Right Now / Legacy sections) — paywall never shown, confirming permanent premium on the seeded account works. Tapped bell (home-bell) → Settings screen renders with Budget Alerts section (master 'Enable alerts' switch ON, category groups Give/Steward/Grow/Enjoy expandable). Tapped 'Notification Details' → NotificationsSheet opens as a bottom sheet with 5 toggles (Daily check-in, Weekly summary, Streak reminders, Large transactions, Weekly digest all ON) and 'Save preferences' button — no red-screen, no crashes, no PAGEERRORs. Only expected console noise: expo-notifications web-push warning (Expo web preview limitation, non-issue) and 'shadow*' style-props deprecated warning (RN Web deprecation, not related to this review).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — pre-existing across the app (not introduced by this iteration). Non-blocking, cosmetic warning. Reference: any component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.

critical_code_review_comments: budget_alert_service.py:158-166 100%-exact vs over-budget branching is correct: `over > 0.005` (half-cent slop for float rounding) → 'Budget exceeded' with $X.XX over; else → 'Budget fully used' — exactly what the review request specified. Verified by tests 3 and 4.

budget_alert_service.py:219-222 inclusive threshold: `if amt <= 0: return None; if amt < threshold: return None` — a transaction of exactly the threshold ($500==500) falls through both guards and fires. This is the off-by-one fix and it is correct. Verified by tests 8, 9, 10.

budget_alert_service.py:100-106 _claim() uses insert_one with DuplicateKeyError to atomically claim the dedupe slot — the composite _id (u/{user}/{period}/{sub}/{type} for budgets, u/{user}/tx/{tx_id}/large_transaction for tx) doubles as an idempotency key. Correct. Note: assumes MongoDB primary-key uniqueness on _id which is the default.
budget_alert_service.py:143 prefs.enabled=false returns [] BEFORE _claim() is called — so a disabled user does not burn dedup slots. Verified by test 7 (row check via direct Mongo).

notifications_router.py:194 + :228 evaluate-budget and evaluate-transaction both use _member_auth() (membership gate) — confirmed by review-account access (premium) returning 200; non-premium users would get 402 (matches paywall contract from iteration 80).

notifications_router.py:93-104 _serialize_notification correctly maps ObjectId → str id, drops _id, and ISO-formats timestamps — no MongoDB-serialization leaks. Verified by inbox test asserting all keys are JSON-friendly.

SettingsScreen.tsx:396-410 the NotificationsSheet UI has 5 toggles (Daily check-in / Weekly summary / Streak reminders / Large transactions / one more) with a 'Save preferences' button, but the code comment at :398 says 'never wired to actual delivery' — this is a UI-only sheet whose Save button calls onSave with a toast message and does NOT PUT /api/notifications/prefs. FYI to main agent: the actual backend prefs shape (perCategory, singleExpense.threshold) is only settable via the Budget Alerts section on the main Settings screen (per-category expandable rows). Not a bug for this review, just noting the two surfaces exist.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest: prefs round-trip, 80%, 100% exact, over-budget, dedupe, under-threshold, prefs-off, tx inclusive $500, tx below, tx above, tx dedupe, inbox+read, push-layer reached, cleanup)

rca_of_issue: N/A — main-agent fixes are complete and correct. Off-by-one root cause was `amt <= threshold → return None` (strict), meaning an amount equal to the threshold silently no-op'd; the fix changes it to `amt < threshold → return None` so equality fires. Corresponding frontend index.tsx line ~555 already watches mergedTransactions (manual + Plaid/imported) so both sources trigger evaluation. All 5 branching arms (below, at, above, dedupe-below, dedupe-at) are covered by tests 8/9/10/11 above.
